14840.d: The Kal'gerion resource dungeon is a resource dungeon on the south-western side of the Daemonheim peninsula.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text: Using the hoardstalker ring obtained from Sinkholes, or using the Dungeoneering cape perk (0,9), are the most convenient methods of reaching the dungeon. Players can also use the ring of kinship and run south-west of their location to reach the dungeon. It is also very close to the Wilderness entrance to Daemonheim, however players cannot pass into Daemonheim if they are in combat.
